faq.q: What specific material properties make Titanium Camera Hot Shoe Mount suitable for Camera accessory hot shoe mounting plate?
faq.a: Titanium Camera Hot Shoe Mount uses Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V because its yield strength, fatigue endurance, and corrosion resistance directly address camera hardware operational demands. The alloy's specific strength enables mass reduction without section compromise, while the TiO2 passivation ensures long-term environmental resistance.

faq.q: What are the critical dimensional tolerances for Titanium Camera Hot Shoe Mount?
faq.a: Standard machining tolerance is +/-0.05mm (ISO 2768-m). Functional mating surfaces are held to +/-0.025mm with Ra 0.8um finish. Threaded features conform to ISO 965-2 Class 6g, verified with calibrated Go/No-Go ring gauges on 100% of production.

faq.q: Does Titanium Camera Hot Shoe Mount require any post-machining surface treatment?
faq.a: Yes. camera hardware components receive PVD TiAlN coating (2-3um, HV2500 hardness) for scratch resistance and uniform gunmetal aesthetic finish. This restores the natural TiO2 passive layer removed during machining and provides the required surface properties for the service environment.

faq.q: What quality documentation is included with Titanium Camera Hot Shoe Mount shipments?
faq.a: Each shipment includes: (1) EN 10204 Type 3.1 MTR with full chemical analysis and mechanical properties; (2) Certificate of Conformance; (3) Dimensional inspection report with actual vs nominal measurements; (4) Surface roughness certification on critical features. FAIR available on request.
